headline: Congress goes quiet on the road to Election Day—both chambers in pro forma mode Friday.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate held a pro forma session on Tuesday, October 6, meeting for just 33 seconds at 1:31 p.m. and immediately adjourning. No legislative business was conducted; the chamber is in recess mode.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House held a brief session on Tuesday, October 6, lasting just 2 minutes. Seventeen new bills (H.R. 10751–10767) and five resolutions were introduced. Two committee reports filed on veterans' appeals and cemetery administration matters. No votes were taken.
